To be honest, game itself good... IF u don't want get any cosmetic easy 
Game full of dark patterns, game models beautiful and game play enjoyable and IF u have more time than money, u like beauty and rogelike games, than this game for you
IF anything that I discribe higher isn't about u, than I strongly DON"T recommend it, only if u have immunity to dark patterns :D

I personally have not experience any of the performance that is reported in the other reviews, that not to say it not happening, but from my experience with my mid tier PC, there has been no performance issue. Perhaps I'm lucky. 

TLDR: I really like the game but it a real shame to see it not do so well. The game overall isn't super remarkable  but I has a solid foundation. It would be a shame to see it unable to find it own playerbase. Perhaps they can preserve the game by converting it into a single player game like Risk of Rain 2. If they feel generous then perhaps update it. 


Pro:
- Fun gameplay loop with replayability
- Personally, I really like the character design are interesting and stands out, although some a bit too flashy and stereotypical
- Builds are super fun and really fun to pop off and steamroll hard boss
- Lore note seem interesting enough for me to keep reading.
- Personal character build with node are fun
- Gunplay seem really fun and responsive
- Difficulty curve balance, get harder later
- Characters ability stand out among each other, leave room for theory crafting 
- Give enough free stuff for a F2P player to have fun and experiment with

Con:
- not a fan of everything being "inside a simulation"
- some voice acting seem off, not the best
- The game is overly flashy, especially that first level in Ring City. It can be offputting. Shouldve set the desert as the first level.
- There are clearly some build that scale better than other on higher difficulty (wealth)
- some character lock behind battlepass or paywall

I actually really liked this game.... tried to play now... i see all my progress was reset back to the first stage and when i try to queue it wont even let me in? counts down and im stuck on the lobby still...

I'm not having any of the performance issues other people are having, oven though I'm on max settings with a 2080 while I've seen reviews with 3070s or 4070s that can't even open the game. I am having the same "What's the point of this?" thoughts as another person put it, but it's kind of fun? I have no idea what I'm doing most of the time but enemies just keep disappearing off of my screen. Voice acting isn't very good and there isn't a lot of it. At least it doesn't spam you with live service bs even though it is one, so you can definitely enjoy playing without spending a dime. For now I'll recommend it, not sure if it will stay that way depending on if they update the game or not.
